worked_solution:
We start by creating a matrix whose columns are made up of our vectors, and then we reduce the matrix to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, our matrix is already in a row echelon form.

The pivot columns correspond to basis vectors, while the non-pivot columns correspond to linearly dependent vectors that can be removed. Here, the reduced matrix has $1$ pivot column (or alternatively, $1$ non-zero row). 

Therefore,
$\text{dim}(\text{Span}{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]})=1.$
